columns.description: date on which transfere from one club to another happened

actionDescriptor.description: Shows mox expensive manchester united player in each season

models.query:
WITH TRANSFERS AS (
  SELECT * FROM `drawingfire-b72a8.football_data.TRANSFERS`
)

, TEST AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM TRANSFERS
  WHERE
    1 = 1
    AND TO_CLUB_ID = 985
  ORDER BY TRANSFER_DATE DESC
)

SELECT *
FROM TEST
QUALIFY
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY TRANSFER_SEASON
    ORDER BY TRANSFER_FEE DESC
  ) = 1
ORDER BY TRANSFER_DATE DESC
